name: quenching
description: Marketplace hosting the quenching plugin: a three-front aligner (the docs/ OKF bundle, the native specs/ spec-driven workspace, the .claude/ command surface) with one align per front and one conductor over all three, plus an inserter, a spec creator and triager, a knowledge-capturer, a glossary-curator, a memory-to-docs migrator, a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md harness-refactorer, an external-source importer, command/agent/hook minters, and a native spec cycle (no external CLI, no delta) for the Claude Code surface of any repository.

plugins.name: quenching
plugins.description: Forces any repository's three quenching fronts into one canonical shape and keeps them conformant: the docs/ Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.1) bundle, the native specs/ spec-driven workspace, and the .claude/ command surface. One align per front — /quenching:knowledge:align, /specs:align, /quenching:components:align — plus the root /align, which conducts all three in dependency order on one confirmation and loops across them until nothing changes anywhere, because they feed each other. Every align is probe-first: a front that is already conformant costs a couple of tool calls and stops. Twenty-six commands, one file per entry point — a command's path is its whole identity, with no skills/ tree and no wrapper. Nine /quenching:knowledge:* act on the bundle (add, import, learn, define, glossary-backfill, import-memory, documentation:build, status, align); nine /specs:* drive the native spec cycle (create → develop → execute → conclude, with continue routing between them, plus triage, status, orchestrate and align); seven /quenching:components:* own the automation surface (command:new, agent:new, hook:new, command:eval, command:retro, harness:align, align). Entirely native: no external CLI, no delta, no separate spec store — a spec writes its durable rules straight into docs/standards/, isolated on a real git branch whose per-task commits it records, and one deterministic stdlib Python entry point, one pillar per front, gives every command deterministic rails behind a uniform --json and strict exit codes. Every command keeps default invocation: typable at /, and reachable by name or by description. Every repository that adopts it looks the same.
